dataset.note: The README format section still uses original S/M filenames; the download commands and pinned HF card specify cleaned S. Metadata and LFS pointer were read; the dataset was not downloaded during this build.

answer.choices: Common direct-reading prompt for every arm, including empty history. Native retrieved text stays in retrieval order; no extra extraction, expansion or per-arm prompt. UTF-8 byte count plus 32 frames a conservative byte-BPE input budget because no arbitrary endpoint tokenizer is exposed. Provider prompt_tokens are retained and exceeding the cap stops scoring.
answer.upstream_benchmark_setting_not_applied: README L180 recommends con reading; per-chunk extraction/CoN at run_generation.py L193-L222 is not applied. Upstream tokenizer-specific truncation L265-L277 is not copied with a tokenizer guessed for arbitrary model IDs.

judge.parsing: 'yes' in response.strip().lower(), exactly as upstream; abstention if '_abs' occurs in question_id.
judge.adaptation: Caller-selected judge model/base URL; one recorded request with no hidden backoff retries.

vectorize_reference.taken: Question-level isolation; lowercase whitespace BM25 tokens and deterministic score ranking.
vectorize_reference.not_taken: Automatic dataset download, chunk splitting, rewritten reader/JSON judge prompts, or gold IDs derived from has_answer; use official answer_session_ids and official judge instead.

bm25.adaptation: Standard-library scoring port, no library install. One whole session per document; both roles, lowercase whitespace tokens, input-order tie breaks. Official LME indexes user-only literal-space tokens at run_retrieval.py L202-L229; that corpus setting is not applied. Empty corpora are supported. No models, service, port, or disk store. Reset discards the previous namespace entirely.

none.adaptation: Required no-context ablation: ingest accepts and discards sessions; recall returns []; uses the same common reader prompt with empty history. No models, service, port, disk store, or persistent namespace.

statistics.method: 95% percentile bootstrap of mean accuracy; paired question differences resampled together. Holm adjustment accepts caller-supplied p-values, with no p-values guessed from bootstrap intervals.

bootstrap_reference.adaptation: Standard-library implementation of the cited percentile algorithm; SciPy default BCa and default resample count are not applied.

chat_completions_reference.note: Bearer authentication from the named environment variable; non-streaming JSON choices[0].message.content and usage. Legacy max_tokens and temperature=0 are retained to match LongMemEval; use a compatible model. Failed requests retain returned usage or unknown usage; no automatic retry.

corrections.finding: Removing has_answer alone does not blind ingestion: original dataset session IDs mark evidence with answer prefixes.
corrections.fix: protocol.py assigns opaque chronological session IDs before ingestion, then maps returned IDs back only inside the scorer. test_core.py verifies original answer-marked IDs are absent from adapter input and answer prompts.

corrections.finding: An ID-bearing hit on one question does not establish provenance for another question's nonempty, unreported retrieval.
corrections.fix: recall_at_k skips nonempty results without IDs; summary never infers provenance across questions. Partial provenance is explicitly a reported-ID coverage lower bound, checked by test_mixed_provenance_is_labeled_and_counted_as_a_lower_bound. Empty results count zero only for explicitly ID-capable controls.

corrections.finding: Summarizing only completed answers understated paid pending ingestion/answer costs, and checkpointing only answers allowed a successful judge call to repeat after a torn append.
corrections.fix: Partial summaries count all observed attempts while accuracy/recall use completed questions; scored pending entries replay without a model call. Failed model attempts retain returned or unknown usage across resume.
